Contract EnterValidatedCreditReferencesModule::chooseLoanRequest(requestid: Integer): LoanRequest {
	definition:
		obs: Set(LoanRequest) = CurrentLoanRequests->select(o|o.RequestID = requestid)
	precondition:
		obs.size()>0
	postcondition:
		let ob: LoanRequest = obs->any(o|o.RequestID = requestid) in
		CurrentLoanRequest = ob and
		result = CurrentLoanRequest
}
